name: Schladming-Dachstein (Planai & Hochwurzen, Reiteralm, Hauser Kaibling)
locality: Schladming, Rohrmoos, Haus im Ennstal and Pichl (Reiteralm)
operator: Planai-Hochwurzen-Bahnen with the Hauser Kaibling and Reiteralm lift companies

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate Schladming town; other bases at Rohrmoos (Hochwurzen), Haus im Ennstal (Hauser Kaibling) and Pichl (Reiteralm)

Piste reference data — confirm at source. The 2,015 m summit (Hauser Kaibling) came from a search summary; the ~745 m base (Schladming valley stations) is Piste reference data; vertical derived as the difference

Search summaries: 123 km of connected slopes (47.3 km easy, 67.3 km intermediate, 8.4 km difficult — percentages derived from these km) and 43 lifts per the region. skiresort.info (https://www.skiresort.info/ski-resort/schladming-planai-hochwurzen-hauser-kaibling-reiteralm-4-berge-skischaukel/test-result/lifts-cable-cars/) lists 11 gondola lifts (including the Obertalbahn chair/gondola combination), 18 chairlifts and 12 T-bar/button lifts (41 typed) with a total capacity of 84,707 persons/hour. planai.at (2026-10-03): the 4-mountain ski area has '123 kilometers of pistes'.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Ski schools and rental shops operate at the bases

character: The 4-Berge-Skischaukel links Reiteralm, Hochwurzen, Planai and Hauser Kaibling above Schladming in the Enns valley of Styria on one ticket, and it is part of the Ski amadé network. Most of the 123 km are blue and red runs up to 2,015 m, and since 2025-26 a 10-seat gondola and an 8-seat chairlift link Hauser Kaibling and Planai.
